personality_one_liner: High-contrast command-center operations surface engineered for split-second crisis response, live telemetry, and zero-friction human-approved dispatch.

spacing.rule: Generous tactical margins with zero clutter, optimizing glanceability and touch targets in emergency states.

do's: Use solid tactical tonal separation for high stress
dont's: No heavy blurs or low-contrast translucent overlays that impair data scanning

screens.name: CitizenEmergencyView
screens.purpose: Provides single-tap SOS activation, real-time incident status tracking, and direct situational reporting.

states.loading: Active GPS lock spinner with radar pulse animation
states.empty: No active SOS. Ready to broadcast emergency alert.
states.error: GPS / Network failure retry banner with manual location picker

screens.layout: Sticky top status bar, huge one-touch SOS trigger button in bottom thumb zone, live incident progress timeline, and quick-report categories (Building Collapse, Trapped Person, Medical, Fire).

screens.name: CommandCenterQueue
screens.purpose: Enables operators and command admins to review AI recommendations and perform human-approved dispatch actions.

states.loading: Streaming active telemetry feeds and AI confidence scoring skeletons
states.empty: All regional incidents resolved or under control.
states.error: Connection lost to central CAD websocket. Reconnecting...

screens.layout: Top filter pills for severity and emergency type, incident priority cards with AI confidence badges, bottom action bar for human approval and responder unit assignment.

screens.name: ResponderMissionControl
screens.purpose: Equips field responders with turn-by-turn routing, unit status updates (EN_ROUTE, ON_SCENE), and encrypted tactical feeds.

states.loading: Acquiring secure responder telemetry and routing vectors
states.empty: No active dispatches assigned to unit.
states.error: Unable to verify secure encrypted channel. Retry handshake.

screens.layout: Tactical dark map view with incident coordinates, prominent status transition buttons, live roster telemetry, and secure operational notes.

crisis_map_banner.alt: Tactical emergency map and radar telemetry interface

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure emergency actions (SOS trigger and Dispatch Approval) are extremely clear with minimum 44x44pt touch targets. Maintain strict role-based workspace separation (Citizen, Responder, Operator). AI must only recommend and never autonomously dispatch. Implement real-time status transitions and robust loading/empty/error states across all screens.
